  // fast path: gbnid_id in localStorage tells us immediately if user is logged in at all
  // instant, works even before the gbnID script has loaded
  // does not cover edge cases (blocked user, expired session) - accurate path below fixes that
  function isGbnIdLoggedInFast() {
    try {
      return !!window.localStorage.getItem('gbnid_id');
    } catch (err) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // accurate path: init/onLogin queue pattern, same idea as Piano's tp.push
  // works even if the real gbnID script hasn't loaded yet - the call gets queued
  // onLogin fires once the session is confirmed, no polling needed
  function waitForGbnIdUser(timeout = 10000) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('gbnID onLogin timed out'));
      }, timeout);

      window.gbnID = window.gbnID || [];
      window.gbnID.push([
        'init',
        function () {
          window.gbnID.onLogin(function () {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            resolve(window.gbnID._currentUser);
          });
        },
      ]);
    });
  }

  //  status from a fully-loaded currentUser object
  function getGbnIdStatus(currentUser) {
    if (!currentUser) {
      return 'anonymous';
    }

    const memberships = currentUser.memberships || [];
    return memberships.length > 0 ? 'member' : 'registered';
  }

  function setWindowObj(status) {
    window.userStatus = status;
    console.log(`kam userStatus: ${status}`);

    // notify other scripts e.g. ad slot logic that status is ready
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gbnUserStatusReady', { detail: { status } }));

  function setCookieMemStatus(status) {

    document.cookie = COOKIE + `=${status}; path=/; max-age=` + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 + `;`;
  }

  function updateSubscribeLink(status) {

      link.href = 'https://www.gbnews.com/membership/';
      link.setAttribute('data-og-href', 'https://www.gbnews.com/membership/');

  })();

function getCookie(c_name) {
    if (document.cookie.length > 0) {
        c_start = document.cookie.indexOf(c_name + "=");
        if (c_start != -1) {
            c_start = c_start + c_name.length + 1;
            c_end = document.cookie.indexOf(";", c_start);
            if (c_end == -1) {
                c_end = document.cookie.length;
            }
            return unescape(document.cookie.substring(c_start, c_end));
        }
    }
    return "";
}

    586688191: "non content",
    586305100: "event",
    586305124: "qa",
    586304663: "clips",
    586304656: "catchup"
  };

  // Posts without a primary section or author can render these as empty or placeholder text
  const clean = (value) => (!value || ['None', 'undefined', 'null'].includes(value) ? '' : value);

  const top_elements = document.querySelectorAll('article[data-post-id]:not(.opinion-layout__item)');

  top_elements.forEach((post, position) => {
    // Attributes sit on the <article>, or on an inner element (hero)
    const data = post.matches('[data-post-author]')
      ? post.dataset
      : (post.querySelector('[data-post-author]')?.dataset || {});

    const sections = (data.postSections || '').split(/\D+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);
    const post_type = Object.keys(post_types).map(Number).find(key => sections.includes(key));
    const headline_link = post.querySelector('h1 a, h2 a, h3 a, p.typography a');
    const headline = headline_link?.textContent.trim() || '';

    const created = Number(data.postDate);
    const published_date = created
      ? new Date(created * 1000).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', year: 'numeric' })
      : '';

    post.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      // Ignore the synthetic link.click() fired by some components after a card click
      if (!event.isTrusted) return;

      // Section tags and controls don't open the post
      if (event.target.closest('.post-tags__tag, button, input, textarea, select')) return;

      const link = event.target.closest('a') || headline_link;
      if (!link || !link.href || link.href.includes('javascript')) return;

      pa.sendEvent('homepage.click', {
        post_position: position + 1,
        post_headline: headline,
        post_url: link.href,
        post_published_date: published_date,
        post_author: clean(data.postAuthor),
        post_content_section: clean(data.postSection),
        post_content_type: post_types[post_type]
      });
    });
  });

        const PREFIX = 'cache-';
const inFlight = new Map();

function getStorage() {
  try {
    return typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.sessionStorage : null;
  } catch {
    return null; // access itself can throw (SecurityError)
  }
}

const CustomCacheAdapter = {
  // Returns undefined on a miss. undefined can't be cached anyway, since JSON can't represent it.
  get(key) {
    const storage = getStorage();
    if (!storage) return undefined;
    try {
      const raw = storage.getItem(PREFIX + key);
      if (raw === null) return undefined;

      const item = JSON.parse(raw);
      const valid = item && typeof item.validTill === 'number' && 'val' in item && item.validTill > Date.now();

      if (!valid) {
        storage.removeItem(PREFIX + key); // clean up expired or corrupt entries
        return undefined;
      }
      return item.val;
    } catch {
      return undefined;
    }
  },

  set(key, val, validity = 5 * 60 * 1000) {
    const storage = getStorage();
    if (!storage || val === undefined) return;
    try {
      storage.setItem(PREFIX + key, JSON.stringify({ val, validTill: Date.now() + validity }));
    } catch {
      // Quota exceeded or storage unavailable: caching is best-effort, so ignore
    }
  },

  delete(key) {
    try {
      getStorage()?.removeItem(PREFIX + key);
    } catch {}
  },
};

function getOrSetCachedItem(key, callback, validity) {
  const cached = CustomCacheAdapter.get(key);
  if (cached !== undefined) return Promise.resolve(cached);

  // Share one request between concurrent callers
  if (inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key);

  const promise = (async () => {
    try {
      const res = await callback();
      CustomCacheAdapter.set(key, res, validity);
      return res;
    } finally {
      inFlight.delete(key);
    }
  })();

  inFlight.set(key, promise);
  return promise;
}

// Values passed into this component through create_element props get
// HTML-escaped once more on output ("&" -> "&amp;"), so getAttribute()
// can still return "&", "'" etc. Decode until nothing changes.
function decodeEntities(value) {
  if (!value) return value;
  const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
  let previous;
  while (value !== previous) {
    previous = value;
    textarea.innerHTML = value;
    value = textarea.value;
  }
  return value;
}

function setupSticky(wrapper, media) {
  if (!wrapper) return;

  const desktop = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)');
  let dismissed = false;
  let scrolledPast = false;

  const closeBtn = document.createElement('button');
  closeBtn.type = 'button';
  closeBtn.className = 'video-player__sticky-close';
  closeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close floating player');
  closeBtn.textContent = '×';
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    dismissed = true;
    update();
  });
  media.appendChild(closeBtn);

  function update() {
    const shouldStick = scrolledPast && desktop.matches && !dismissed;
    if (shouldStick === wrapper.classList.contains('is-sticky')) return;

    if (shouldStick) {
      // Hold the player's original space so the page doesn't jump when the media goes fixed
      wrapper.style.height = `${wrapper.offsetHeight}px`;
      wrapper.classList.add('is-sticky');
    } else {
      wrapper.classList.remove('is-sticky');
      wrapper.style.height = '';
    }
  }

  // scoped to this component instance
  REBELMOUSE_STDLIB.onElementInViewport({
    // selector: `[data-node-id='${componentid}'] .video-player.audio-video-wrapper,[data-node-id='${componentid}'] audio-video-wrapper`,
    selector: `[data-node-id='${componentid}'] .audio-video-wrapper`,
    threshold: 0,
    onAboveViewport: () => {
      // Scrolled down past the player → float it
      scrolledPast = true;
      update();
    },
    onIntersect: () => {
      // Back in view → return it to its normal spot
      scrolledPast = false;
      update();
    },
    onBellowViewport: () => {
      // Scrolled up past the player
      scrolledPast = false;
      update();
    },
  });

  desktop.addEventListener('change', update);
}

function playPerceptionLive(container) {
  if (container.dataset.embedStarted) return;
  container.dataset.embedStarted = 'true';

  const containerId = `perception_player_${Date.now()}_${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}`;
  container.id = containerId;

  const contentId = '385';

  function init() {
    const livePlayer = window.PlayerController.init({
      containerId,
      contentType: 'tv',
      contentId,
      autoplay: useAutoplay ? 'muted' : 'off',
    });

    if (!livePlayer) return;
    let previewTimer = null;

    registerPlayer(container, () => {
      // Paused by another player: cancel the preview countdown so the
      // "watch live" overlay doesn't appear later for no visible reason
      previewTimer && clearTimeout(previewTimer);
      previewTimer = null;
      livePlayer.pause();
    });

    if (livePlayer && useAutoplay) {
      livePlayer.on('ready', () => {
        livePlayer.play();
      });
    }

    livePlayer.on('playing', () => {
      claimPlayback(container);
      if (previewSeconds > 0) {
        if (previewTimer) return; // live streams can re-fire 'playing' after buffering
        previewTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          livePlayer.pause();
          addLiveRedirect(container);
          previewTimer = null;
        }, previewSeconds * 1000);
      }
    });

    if (props.stickyOnScroll) {
      setupSticky(container.closest('.video-player'), container);
    }
  }

  if (window.PlayerController) {
    init();
    return;
  }

  if (!document.querySelector('script[src="https://gbnews.perception.tv/perception_controller.js"]')) {
    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://gbnews.perception.tv/perception_controller.js';
    script.onload = init;
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  } else {
    const check = setInterval(() => {
      if (window.PlayerController) {
        clearInterval(check);
        init();
      }
    }, 50);
  }
}

function playStandardVideo(media) {
  if (media.dataset.embedStarted) return;
  media.dataset.embedStarted = 'true';

  let src = decodeEntities(media.getAttribute('data-video-src'));
  if (!src) return;

  const isScraperVideo = src.includes('res/scraper/embed/?video_url=');

  if (isScraperVideo) {
    const parts = src.split('res/scraper/embed/?video_url=');
    try {
      src = parts && parts[1] && decodeURIComponent(parts[1]);
    } catch (err) {
      // Malformed %-encoding (e.g. a stray "%"): leave the poster and play button in place
      console.warn('Invalid scraper video URL:', err);
      return;
    }
    if (!src) return;
  }

  removeBgImg(media);
  removePlayBtn(media);

  if (isScraperVideo) {
    media.classList.add('video-player__media--legacy-primis');
    const video = document.createElement('video');
    video.muted = true;
    video.setAttribute('controls', '');
    video.setAttribute('autoplay', '');
    video.setAttribute('muted', '');
    video.setAttribute('name', 'media');
    video.setAttribute('crossorigin', 'anonymous');
    video.src = src;
    media.appendChild(video);

    registerPlayer(media, () => video.pause());
    video.addEventListener('play', () => claimPlayback(media));

    video.play().catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Autoplay failed:', err);
    });
  } else {
    const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
    iframe.setAttribute('src', src);
    iframe.setAttribute('allow', 'autoplay; fullscreen');
    iframe.setAttribute('allowfullscreen', 'allowfullscreen');
    iframe.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
    media.appendChild(iframe);
  }
}

// play button until the player has actually rendered; if the script fails or
// nothing renders in time, swap in the article's own Simplestream video instead
// of leaving a black box. Nothing autoplays in that fallback.
const PRIMIS_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000;

function primisFallbackSrc() {
  let src = decodeEntities(props.videoURL || '');
  if (!src) return '';
  if (src.includes('res/scraper/embed/?video_url=')) {
    try {
      src = decodeURIComponent(src.split('res/scraper/embed/?video_url=')[1] || '');
    } catch (err) {
      return '';
    }
  }
  return /^https?:\/\//.test(src) ? src : '';
}

function watchPrimisEmbed(media, script) {
  const hasRendered = () => !!media.querySelector('[data-primis-wrapper], #primisPlayerContainerDiv, iframe, video');
  let settled = false;
  let timer = null;
  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    if (hasRendered()) settle(true);
  });
  function settle(rendered) {
    if (settled) return;
    settled = true;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    observer.disconnect();
    if (rendered) {
      removePlayBtn(media);
      removeBgImg(media);
    } else {
      showPrimisFallback(media);
    }
  }
  observer.observe(media, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  timer = setTimeout(() => settle(hasRendered()), PRIMIS_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS);
  script.addEventListener('error', () => settle(false));
}

// bfcache restore: a restored Primis player doesn't reliably accept play() again, so instead of
// resuming it, put this instance's started Primis players back exactly as on first load (from the
// snapshots) and, on autoplay instances, start them through the same playMedia path. Primis
// players are keyed in the registry by their player object, so the old ones are paused and
// dropped; the new ones register themselves again through primisPlayerInit.
function rebuildPrimisPlayers() {
  const started = [...instance.querySelectorAll('[data-primis-slot]')].filter((media) => media.dataset.embedStarted);
  if (!started.length) return;

  playerinstances.forEach((pause, key) => {
    if (key instanceof Element) return;
    try {
      pause();
    } catch (err) {
      // the old player may already be gone
    }
    playerinstances.delete(key);
  });

  started.forEach((media) => {
    const freshMedia = primisSnapshots.get(media.dataset.primisSlot)?.cloneNode(true);
    if (!freshMedia) return;
    media.replaceWith(freshMedia);
    if (useAutoplay) playMedia(freshMedia);
  });
}

    return document.querySelectorAll('.post-loyalty-balance');
  }

  function isGbnLoggedIn() {
    try {
      return !!window.localStorage.getItem('gbnid_id');
    } catch (err) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function formatBalance(value) {
    var n = Number(value);
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(n)) return '';
    return n.toLocaleString('en-GB');
  }

  // No balance (guest, not opted in, or lookup failed) shows the join link instead
  function render() {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(getRoots(), function (root) {
      var valueEl = root.querySelector('.post-loyalty-balance__balance-value');
      if (valueEl) valueEl.textContent = formatBalance(balance);
      root.setAttribute('data-state', balance == null ? 'join' : 'balance');
    });
  }

  function setBalance(value) {
    balance = value;
    render();
  }

  function applyProfile(profile) {
    if (!profile || !profile.gamificationConsent) {
      setBalance(null);
      return;
    }
    setBalance((profile.wallet && profile.wallet.loyaltyPoints) || 0);
  }

  function lookupBalance(gbnCE) {
    var version = ++balanceVersion;

    Promise.resolve()
      .then(function () {
        return gbnCE.auth.getUserProfile();
      })
      .then(function (profile) {
        if (version === balanceVersion) applyProfile(profile);
      })
      .catch(function (err) {
        console.error('[LoyaltyBalance] getUserProfile error:', err);
        if (version === balanceVersion) setBalance(null);
      });

  function fetchBalance() {

      lookupBalance(window.gbnCE);
    }

    if (typeof window.gbnCE.push === 'function') {
      window.gbnCE.push(['init', lookupBalance]);

    balanceVersion++;
    setBalance(null);
  }

  function watchAuth() {
    function onGbnIDReady() {
      var gbnID = window.gbnID;
      if (typeof gbnID.onLogin === 'function') {
        gbnID.onLogin(function () {
          fetchBalance();
        });
      }
      if (typeof gbnID.onLogout === 'function') {
        gbnID.onLogout(onLogout);
      }

      return;

    }
    window.addEventListener('load', render);

})

  function initPresenterCards(scope) {
    var root = scope || document;
    var cards = root.querySelectorAll('.opinion-layout__item');

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(cards, function (card) {
      if (card.dataset.presenterProcessed === 'true') return;

      var presenterName = (card.getAttribute('data-presenter') || '').trim();
      if (!presenterName || presenterName === 'None' || presenterName === 'null') {
        card.dataset.presenterProcessed = 'true';
        return;
      }

      var presenterData = presenterMap[presenterName];
      if (!presenterData || !presenterData.url || !presenterData.image) {
        card.dataset.presenterProcessed = 'true';
        return;
      }

      var img = card.querySelector('.opinion-layout__image');
      var nameEl = card.querySelector('.opinion-layout__author');
      if (img) {
        img.src = presenterData.image;
        img.alt = presenterName;
      }
      if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = presenterName;

      card.dataset.presenterProcessed = 'true';
    });
  }

  function hideTrailingDividers(row) {
    var kids = row.children;
    for (var i = kids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      if (kids[i].classList.contains('opinion-layout__divider')) {
        kids[i].style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  function setupCarousel(root) {
    var row = root.querySelector('[data-opinion-carousel]');
    var dotsWrap = root.querySelector('[data-opinion-dots]');
    if (!row || !dotsWrap || row.getAttribute('data-carousel-ready') === '1') return;

    hideTrailingDividers(row);

    var items = row.querySelectorAll('.opinion-layout__item');
    if (!items.length) return;

    row.setAttribute('data-carousel-ready', '1');

    function pageCount() {
      var view = row.clientWidth;
      if (view <= 0) return 1;
      return Math.max(1, Math.round(row.scrollWidth / view));
    }

    function pageWidth() {
      var count = pageCount();
      if (count <= 1) return row.clientWidth;
      return (row.scrollWidth - row.clientWidth) / (count - 1) || row.clientWidth;
    }

    function buildDots() {
      var count = pageCount();
      dotsWrap.innerHTML = '';
      dotsWrap.style.display = count <= 1 ? 'none' : '';

      for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        (function (index) {
          var dot = document.createElement('button');
          dot.type = 'button';
          dot.className = 'opinion-layout__dot' + (index === 0 ? ' is-active' : '');
          dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (index + 1));
          dot.addEventListener('click', function () {
            row.scrollTo({ left: pageWidth() * index, behavior: 'smooth' });
          });
          dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
        })(i);
      }
    }

    function syncDots() {
      var dots = dotsWrap.querySelectorAll('.opinion-layout__dot');
      if (!dots.length) return;

      var step = pageWidth();
      var active = step <= 0 ? 0 : Math.round(row.scrollLeft / step);
      if (active < 0) active = 0;
      if (active > dots.length - 1) active = dots.length - 1;

      Array.prototype.forEach.call(dots, function (dot, index) {
        if (index === active) dot.classList.add('is-active');
        else dot.classList.remove('is-active');
      });
    }

    buildDots();
    row.addEventListener('scroll', syncDots, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      buildDots();
      syncDots();
    });
    syncDots();
  }

  function init() {
    var roots = document.querySelectorAll('.opinion-layout');
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(roots, function (root) {
      initPresenterCards(root);
      setupCarousel(root);
    });
  }

  init();

  if (typeof REBELMOUSE_STDLIB !== 'undefined' && REBELMOUSE_STDLIB.createElementChangeListener) {
    REBELMOUSE_STDLIB.createElementChangeListener('.opinion-layout', function (layout) {
      initPresenterCards(layout);
    });
  }
})();

      const RSS_URL = 'https://kunnusta.io/api/v1/providers/mimir/mrss?tenant=gbnews';

function decodeXmlEntities(value) {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, "'")
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>');
}

async function fetchVideoData() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(RSS_URL);

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to fetch videos: ${response.status}`);
    }

    const xmlText = await response.text();

    // Get all <item>...</item> blocks
    const itemMatches = xmlText.match(/<item>[\s\S]*?<\/item>/g) || [];

    const videoData = itemMatches.map((item, index) => {
      // Title
      const titleMatch = item.match(/<title>\s*<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>\s*<\/title>/);

      const title = titleMatch ? titleMatch[1].trim() : '';

      // GUID
      const guidMatch = item.match(/<guid[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/guid>/);

      const guid = guidMatch ? guidMatch[1].trim() : '';

      // Thumbnail
      const thumbnailMatch = item.match(/<media:thumbnail[^>]*url="([^"]+)"/);

      // Video
      const videoMatch = item.match(/<media:content[^>]*url="([^"]+)"/);

      const thumbnail = thumbnailMatch ? decodeXmlEntities(thumbnailMatch[1]) : '';

      const videoUrl = videoMatch ? decodeXmlEntities(videoMatch[1]) : '';

      return {
        // Keep numeric IDs to match your existing data structure
        id: index + 1,

        title,

        thumbnail,

        videoUrl,

        action: null,
      };
    });

    return videoData;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching video data:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

      });

      // Share button event
      const shareButton = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-btn--share');
      shareButton.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        openShareModal(video, slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video'));
      });

      // Video click play/pause
      const videoElement = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
      videoElement.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (videoElement.paused) {
          videoElement.play().catch(() => {});
        } else {
          videoElement.pause();
        }
      });

      // Sync play overlay state using video events
      videoElement.addEventListener('play', () => {
        slide.classList.remove('is-paused');
      });

      videoElement.addEventListener('pause', () => {
        slide.classList.add('is-paused');
      });

      // Initial state is paused
      slide.classList.add('is-paused');

      // Update progress bar
      const progressBar = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__progress-bar');
      videoElement.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
        if (videoElement.duration) {
          const pct = (videoElement.currentTime / videoElement.duration) * 100;
          progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }
      });

      // Seek video on progress container click
      const progressContainer = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__progress-container');
      progressContainer.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
        const rect = progressContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        const clickX = event.clientX - rect.left;
        const pct = clickX / rect.width;
        if (videoElement.duration) {
          videoElement.currentTime = pct * videoElement.duration;
        }
      });

      slidesContainer.appendChild(slide);
    });
  }

  // Open detail view and navigate to selected index
  function openViewer(video) {
    closeFloatingPlayer();

    renderViewerSlides();

    viewer.classList.add('is-open');
    viewer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

    if (isMobileViewport() && !viewerHistoryActive) {
      history.pushState({ videoViewer: true }, '');
      viewerHistoryActive = true;
    }

    const index = videoData.findIndex((item) => item.id === video.id);
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');

    setTimeout(() => {
      const slideHeight = slidesContainer.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
      slidesContainer.scrollTop = index * slideHeight;
      lastActiveIndex = -1;
      handleSlideChange();
    }, 50);
  }

  // Close detail view and reset playback
  function closeViewer() {
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
    if (slidesContainer) {
      const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');
      slides.forEach((slide) => {
        const vid = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
        if (vid) {
          vid.pause();
          vid.removeAttribute('src');
          vid.load();
        }
      });
    }

    viewer.classList.remove('is-open');
    viewer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    closeShareModal();
    lastActiveIndex = -1;

    if (viewerHistoryActive) {
      viewerHistoryActive = false;
      history.back();
    }
  }

  // On mobile, treat the back gesture/button as "minimize to PiP" instead of leaving the page
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function () {
    if (!viewerHistoryActive) return;
    viewerHistoryActive = false;

    const shareModal = document.getElementById('video-viewer-share-modal');
    if (shareModal && shareModal.classList.contains('is-open')) {
      closeShareModal();
      return;
    }

    if (viewer.classList.contains('is-open')) {
      openPictureInPicture();
    }
  });

  // Handle active slide changed during scroll
  function handleSlideChange() {
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
    if (!slidesContainer) return;

    const slideHeight = slidesContainer.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
    if (!slideHeight) return;

    const activeIndex = Math.round(slidesContainer.scrollTop / slideHeight);
    if (activeIndex === lastActiveIndex) return;

    const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');

    // Pause previous video slide
    if (lastActiveIndex >= 0 && lastActiveIndex < slides.length) {
      const prevSlide = slides[lastActiveIndex];
      const prevVideo = prevSlide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
      if (prevVideo) {
        prevVideo.pause();
        prevVideo.currentTime = 0;
      }
    }

    // Play new active video slide
    if (activeIndex >= 0 && activeIndex < slides.length) {
      const activeSlide = slides[activeIndex];
      const activeVideo = activeSlide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
      const videoObj = videoData[activeIndex];

      if (activeVideo) {
        if (!activeVideo.src) {
          activeVideo.src = videoObj.videoUrl;
        }

        activeVideo.muted = globalMuted;
        updateSoundButtonIcons(activeSlide);

        activeVideo.play().catch((err) => {
          console.log('Autoplay blocked/failed: ', err);
        });
      }

      lastActiveIndex = activeIndex;
      updateChevronButtonsState(activeIndex);
    }
  }

  // Scroll to slide offset
  function scrollToSlide(offset) {
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
    if (!slidesContainer) return;
    const slideHeight = slidesContainer.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
    const targetIndex = lastActiveIndex + offset;

    if (targetIndex >= 0 && targetIndex < videoData.length) {
      slidesContainer.scrollTo({
        top: targetIndex * slideHeight,
        behavior: 'smooth',
      });
    }
  }

  // Update chevron visibility and disabled state
  function updateChevronButtonsState(activeIndex) {
    const upButton = document.getElementById('video-viewer-scroll-up');
    const downButton = document.getElementById('video-viewer-scroll-down');
    if (!upButton || !downButton) return;

    upButton.hidden = activeIndex <= 0;
    downButton.hidden = activeIndex >= videoData.length - 1;
  }

  // Global sound toggle
  function toggleMuteGlobal() {
    globalMuted = !globalMuted;
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
    if (!slidesContainer) return;

    const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');
    slides.forEach((slide) => {
      const vid = slide.querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
      if (vid) {
        vid.muted = globalMuted;
      }
      updateSoundButtonIcons(slide);
    });
  }

  function updateSoundButtonIcons(slide) {
    const iconOn = slide.querySelector('.icon-speaker-on');
    const iconOff = slide.querySelector('.icon-speaker-off');
    if (iconOn && iconOff) {
      if (globalMuted) {
        iconOn.style.display = 'none';
        iconOff.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        iconOn.style.display = 'block';
        iconOff.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
  }

  /* ==========================================
     SHARE MODAL POPUP LOGIC
  ========================================== */

  function openShareModal(video, videoElement) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('video-viewer-share-modal');
    modal.classList.add('is-open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    activeShareVideo = videoElement;

    const checkbox = document.getElementById('share-start-at-checkbox');
    if (checkbox) checkbox.checked = false;

    updateShareTimestamp();
  }

  function closeShareModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('video-viewer-share-modal');
    if (modal) {
      modal.classList.remove('is-open');
      modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    }
    activeShareVideo = null;
  }

  function updateShareTimestamp() {
    const checkbox = document.getElementById('share-start-at-checkbox');
    const timeInput = document.getElementById('share-start-at-time');
    if (!timeInput) return;

    if (activeShareVideo) {
      timeInput.value = formatTime(activeShareVideo.currentTime);
    } else {
      timeInput.value = '00:00';
    }
  }

  // Setup share modal options and input events
  function initShareModalEvents() {
    const modalClose = document.getElementById('video-share-modal-close');
    if (modalClose) {
      modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeShareModal);
    }

    const checkbox = document.getElementById('share-start-at-checkbox');
    if (checkbox) {
      checkbox.addEventListener('change', updateShareTimestamp);
    }

    const shareCopy = document.getElementById('share-copy');
    if (shareCopy) {
      shareCopy.addEventListener('click', () => {
        let url = window.location.href.split('?')[0];
        const checkbox = document.getElementById('share-start-at-checkbox');
        const timeInput = document.getElementById('share-start-at-time');

        if (checkbox && checkbox.checked && timeInput) {
          const timeParts = timeInput.value.split(':');
          let secs = 0;
          if (timeParts.length === 2) {
            secs = parseInt(timeParts[0]) * 60 + parseInt(timeParts[1]);
          } else {
            secs = parseInt(timeInput.value) || 0;
          }
          url += `?t=${secs}`;
        }

        navigator.clipboard
          .writeText(url)
          .then(() => {
            const label = shareCopy.querySelector('.video-share-modal__label');
            if (label) {
              const originalText = label.textContent;
              label.textContent = 'Copied!';
              shareCopy.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
              setTimeout(() => {
                label.textContent = originalText;
                shareCopy.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
              }, 1500);
            }
          })
          .catch((err) => {
            console.error('Failed to copy: ', err);
          });
      });
    }

    // Dummy events for other share platforms
    ['facebook', 'x', 'email', 'qr', 'more'].forEach((platform) => {
      const btn = document.getElementById(`share-${platform}`);
      if (btn && platform !== 'copy') {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          console.log(`Sharing to ${platform}...`);
          alert(`Simulating share via ${platform.toUpperCase()}`);
        });
      }
    });
  }

  /* ==========================================
     CLOSE DETAIL VIEW & EVENT LISTENERS
  ========================================== */

  viewerClose.addEventListener('click', closeViewer);

  // Open PiP on backdrop click
  viewer.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (event.target === viewer || event.target.classList.contains('video-viewer__backdrop')) {
      openPictureInPicture();
    }
  });

  // Up and down scroll chevrons
  const upButton = document.getElementById('video-viewer-scroll-up');
  const downButton = document.getElementById('video-viewer-scroll-down');
  if (upButton) {
    upButton.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToSlide(-1));
  }
  if (downButton) {
    downButton.addEventListener('click', () => scrollToSlide(1));
  }

  // Scroll snapping event listener on the slides container
  const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
  if (slidesContainer) {
    slidesContainer.addEventListener('scroll', handleSlideChange);
  }

  const viewerBackdrop = viewer.querySelector('.video-viewer__backdrop');
  if (viewerBackdrop && slidesContainer) {
    viewerBackdrop.addEventListener(
      'wheel',
      (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        slidesContainer.scrollBy({ top: event.deltaY, behavior: 'auto' });
      },
      { passive: false },
    );

    const SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 40;
    let backdropTouchStartY = null;

    viewerBackdrop.addEventListener(
      'touchstart',
      (event) => {
        if (event.touches.length !== 1) return;
        backdropTouchStartY = event.touches[0].clientY;
      },
      { passive: true },
    );

    viewerBackdrop.addEventListener(
      'touchmove',
      (event) => {
        if (backdropTouchStartY === null) return;
        event.preventDefault();
      },
      { passive: false },
    );

    viewerBackdrop.addEventListener('touchend', (event) => {
      if (backdropTouchStartY === null) return;
      const endY = event.changedTouches[0].clientY;
      const deltaY = backdropTouchStartY - endY;
      backdropTouchStartY = null;

      if (Math.abs(deltaY) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
        scrollToSlide(deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1);
      }
    });
  }

  // Handle window resize to align snapped slide
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (viewer.classList.contains('is-open') && lastActiveIndex >= 0 && slidesContainer) {
      const slideHeight = slidesContainer.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
      slidesContainer.scrollTop = lastActiveIndex * slideHeight;
    }
  });

  // Initialize Share Modal Events
  initShareModalEvents();

  /* ==========================================
     CUSTOM PICTURE-IN-PICTURE (MODIFIED)
  ========================================== */

  function openPictureInPicture() {
    const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
    if (!slidesContainer) return;
    const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');
    if (lastActiveIndex < 0 || lastActiveIndex >= slides.length) return;

    const activeVideo = slides[lastActiveIndex].querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
    if (!activeVideo) return;
    const currentSrc = activeVideo.currentSrc || activeVideo.src;

    if (!currentSrc) {
      return;
    }

    activePipVideoIndex = lastActiveIndex; // Save the active slide index to restore later

    floatingVideo.src = currentSrc;
    floatingVideo.currentTime = activeVideo.currentTime;
    floatingVideo.muted = activeVideo.muted;

    floating.classList.add('is-open');
    floating.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

    closeViewer();

    floatingVideo.play().catch(function () {});
  }

  viewerPip.addEventListener('click', openPictureInPicture);

  // Restore video from floating player (PiP) to full detail view
  function restoreFromPictureInPicture() {
    if (activePipVideoIndex < 0 || activePipVideoIndex >= videoData.length) return;

    const targetVideo = videoData[activePipVideoIndex];
    const savedTime = floatingVideo.currentTime;
    const wasPaused = floatingVideo.paused;

    closeFloatingPlayer();
    openViewer(targetVideo);

    // Wait brief delay to allow slide rendering and scrolling to complete
    setTimeout(() => {
      const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
      if (!slidesContainer) return;
      const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');
      if (activePipVideoIndex >= 0 && activePipVideoIndex < slides.length) {
        const activeVideo = slides[activePipVideoIndex].querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
        if (activeVideo) {
          activeVideo.currentTime = savedTime;
          if (wasPaused) {
            activeVideo.pause();
          } else {
            activeVideo.play().catch(() => {});
          }
        }
      }
      activePipVideoIndex = -1; // Reset
    }, 120);
  }

  /* ==========================================
     FLOATING PLAY / PAUSE
  ========================================== */

  // Helper to sync play/pause button state in PiP mode
  function updateFloatingPlayToggle() {
    if (!floatingPlayToggle) return;
    const playIcon = floatingPlayToggle.querySelector('.icon-floating-play');
    const pauseIcon = floatingPlayToggle.querySelector('.icon-floating-pause');
    if (!playIcon || !pauseIcon) return;

    if (floatingVideo.paused) {
      playIcon.style.display = 'block';
      pauseIcon.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      playIcon.style.display = 'none';
      pauseIcon.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }

  floatingVideo.addEventListener('play', updateFloatingPlayToggle);
  floatingVideo.addEventListener('pause', updateFloatingPlayToggle);

  // Clicking on floating video container restores detail view
  floatingVideo.addEventListener('click', restoreFromPictureInPicture);

  if (floatingPlayToggle) {
    floatingPlayToggle.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      event.stopPropagation();
      if (floatingVideo.paused) {
        floatingVideo.play().catch(function () {});
      } else {
        floatingVideo.pause();
      }
    });
  }

  // Update floating progress bar
  const floatingProgressBar = document.getElementById('video-floating-progress-bar');
  if (floatingVideo) {
    floatingVideo.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => {
      if (floatingVideo.duration && floatingProgressBar) {
        const pct = (floatingVideo.currentTime / floatingVideo.duration) * 100;
        floatingProgressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
      }
    });
  }

  /* ==========================================
     CLOSE FLOATING PLAYER
  ========================================== */

  function closeFloatingPlayer() {
    floatingVideo.pause();
    floatingVideo.removeAttribute('src');
    floatingVideo.load();
    floating.classList.remove('is-open');
    floating.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  }

  floatingClose.addEventListener('click', closeFloatingPlayer);

  /* ==========================================
     GLOBAL KEYBOARD NAVIGATION
  ========================================== */

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
    // If the user is typing in an input field, let them type
    const activeEl = document.activeElement;
    if (activeEl && (activeEl.tagName === 'INPUT' || activeEl.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || activeEl.isContentEditable)) {
      return;
    }

    const isViewerOpen = viewer.classList.contains('is-open');

    if (isViewerOpen) {
      // Keyboard controls while detail viewer is open
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        const shareModal = document.getElementById('video-viewer-share-modal');
        if (shareModal && shareModal.classList.contains('is-open')) {
          closeShareModal();
        } else {
          closeViewer();
        }
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToSlide(-1);
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollToSlide(1);
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        // Prevent horizontal scroll of background carousel while viewing details
        event.preventDefault();
      } else if (event.key === ' ' || event.code === 'Space') {
        event.preventDefault();
        const slidesContainer = document.getElementById('video-viewer-slides');
        if (slidesContainer && lastActiveIndex >= 0) {
          const slides = slidesContainer.querySelectorAll('.video-viewer__slide');
          if (lastActiveIndex < slides.length) {
            const activeVideo = slides[lastActiveIndex].querySelector('.video-viewer__slide-video');
            if (activeVideo) {
              if (activeVideo.paused) {
                activeVideo.play().catch(() => {});
              } else {
                activeVideo.pause();
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } else {
      // Keyboard controls for main feed carousel (horizontal)
      if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollCarousel(-1);
      } else if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        event.preventDefault();
        scrollCarousel(1);
      } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        if (floating.classList.contains('is-open')) {
          closeFloatingPlayer();
        }
      }
    }
  });

  /* ==========================================
     INITIALIZE
  ========================================== */

  renderVideos();
})();
})

        const base64 = segment.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');

        const payload = JSON.parse(atob(padded));

        currency: 'GBP',
        email: (user && user.email) || '',
        first_name: user && user.name && user.name.first,
        last_name: user && user.name && user.name.last,
        line_items: [
          {
            item_code: 'gbn_donation_other',

        ],
        three_d_secure_action_result_token_id: actionTokenId || '',
        token_id: tokenId,
      };

    // // add turnstileToken to body of the request
    // body.turnstileToken = window.retrievePaymentTurnstileToken();

    if (actionTokenId) {
      body.three_d_secure_action_result_token_id = actionTokenId;
    } else {
      body.turnstileToken = window.retrievePaymentTurnstileToken();

      const res = await fetch(requiredEndpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

  // Remove error indicators cleanly when the user resolves the field value

  const isReallyVisible = (el) => {

    const cs = getComputedStyle(el);

        // ── 5. DETERMINE ACTIVE PAYMENT PANEL ────────────────────────────────

          if (btn) {
            btn.disabled = true;

          // Call Recurly Token explicitly
          // Note: For Recurly Elements, pass `elements` as target
          const recurlyTarget = typeof elements !== 'undefined' ? elements : form;

  // fast path: gbnid_id in localStorage tells us immediately if user is logged in at all
  // instant, works even before the gbnID script has loaded
  // does not cover edge cases (blocked user, expired session) - accurate path below fixes that
  function isGbnIdLoggedInFast() {
    try {
      return !!window.localStorage.getItem('gbnid_id');
    } catch (err) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // accurate path: init/onLogin queue pattern, same idea as Piano's tp.push
  // works even if the real gbnID script hasn't loaded yet - the call gets queued
  // onLogin fires once the session is confirmed, no polling needed
  function waitForGbnIdUser(timeout = 10000) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        reject(new Error('gbnID onLogin timed out'));
      }, timeout);

      window.gbnID = window.gbnID || [];
      window.gbnID.push([
        'init',
        function () {
          window.gbnID.onLogin(function () {
            clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            resolve(window.gbnID._currentUser);
          });
        },
      ]);
    });
  }

  //  status from a fully-loaded currentUser object
  function getGbnIdStatus(currentUser) {
    if (!currentUser) {
      return 'anonymous';
    }

    const memberships = currentUser.memberships || [];
    return memberships.length > 0 ? 'member' : 'registered';
  }

  function setWindowObj(status) {
    window.userStatus = status;
    console.log(`kam userStatus: ${status}`);

    // notify other scripts e.g. ad slot logic that status is ready
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gbnUserStatusReady', { detail: { status } }));
  }

  function setCookieMemStatus(status) {

  }

  function updateSubscribeLink(status) {

          // console.log("hashed email for liveramp called");
          const EMAIL_VALIDATION_REGEX =
            /((([^<>()\[\].,;:\s@"]+(\.[^<>()\[\].,;:\s@"]+)*)|(".+"))@(([^<>()[\].,;:\s@"]+\.)+[^<>()[\].,;:\s@"]{2,}))/i;

          const normalizedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
          const encoder = new TextEncoder();
          const data = encoder.encode(normalizedEmail);
          const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);

function getCookie(c_name) {
    if (document.cookie.length > 0) {
        c_start = document.cookie.indexOf(c_name + "=");
        if (c_start != -1) {
            c_start = c_start + c_name.length + 1;
            c_end = document.cookie.indexOf(";", c_start);
            if (c_end == -1) {
                c_end = document.cookie.length;
            }
            return unescape(document.cookie.substring(c_start, c_end));
        }
    }
    return "";
}
